name: renovate-validator-action
description: Validate a repository's renovate.json with Renovate's official validator

scripts.setup: brew bundle && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm hooks:install
scripts.lint: node --check src/index.js && node --check scripts/check-bundle.js && node --check tests/main.test.js && node --check tests/main.integration.js && actionlint
scripts.analyze: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm bundle:check
scripts.check: pnpm analyze && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration
